purpose: Record published file hashes and their relationship to imported experimental records; mathematical results, recorded costs and historical submission pins are retained.

normalization.description: Recorded paths and storage metadata are prepared for publication while preserving experimental results.
normalization.original_hash_semantics: Original fingerprints describe imported bytes before publication; they are not assumed to match historical submission inventories.
normalization.limitations: The public manifest records declared correspondence and does not reconstruct private original bytes.
